amendment_reason: A development-only, non-confirmatory selftest showed that class_conditioned_minimal_repair is a stronger frozen non-ORION comparator than reflect_evigraph_composite_parent on the registered mechanism fixtures. Strengthen the primary comparator before confirmatory holdout materialization. This amendment makes support harder; it does not relax a margin, change gold, change the confirmatory seed, alter any arm, or inspect confirmatory output.
unchanged: fresh holdout generator and confirmatory seed

primary_hypothesis.text: On a fresh pre-bound authority-value holdout, with identical diagnosis and intervention evidence supplied to every arm, ORION typed permission plus dependency-scoped reopening improves scientifically-valid repair rate by at least 10 percentage points over the frozen class-conditioned minimal-repair parent, while unauthorized epistemic mutation remains <=1% and root-task recovery is non-inferior within 2 percentage points.

support_if_all: paired difference full_orion - class_conditioned_minimal_repair in scientifically_valid_repair_rate >= 0.10
95% paired interval lower bound for that difference > 0.0
95% paired interval lower bound for full_orion - primary_parent root_task_recovery >= -0.02
no registered catastrophic protected-action violation in full_orion
primary_decision_rule.otherwise: NOT_SUPPORTED or REFUTED according to frozen failure taxonomy; margins are never moved after outcome access
